description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'AuthenticateEndpoint' for user authentication in an ASP.NET Core web application. It handles POST requests to authenticate users via SignInManager, and returns authentication results including tokens.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class for authenticating users, utilizing ASP.NET Core's SignInManager and custom token service to authenticate credentials and generate tokens.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the POST request to authenticate a user by verifying credentials and returning a response with authentication status and token if successful.
